# AI Contribution Policy

The use of AI tools in preparing contributions to gostatus is permitted.
Regardless of how a contribution is produced, the contributor remains fully
responsible for it, and all contributions are held to the same standard of
review.

## Understanding your contribution

Contributors must be able to explain and justify any code, issue, or pull
request they submit without relying on an AI tool to do so. If a question
is asked about a contribution and the contributor cannot answer it directly,
the contribution was not ready to be submitted.

## Communication

Issue and pull request descriptions, and responses to maintainers, must be
written by the contributor in their own words. If AI-generated output is
quoted, it must be clearly marked as AI-generated, kept brief, and accompanied
by the contributor's own explanation of its relevance.

## Non-native English speakers

AI tools may be used to correct grammar in the contributor's own writing.
Writing in another language and including a quoted translation alongside the
original is preferred over relying on AI-generated text in place of your own.

## Enforcement

I reserve the right to close issues or pull requests that do not
comply with this policy and to restrict contributors who repeatedly or
clearly violate it. This policy may be revised as circumstances require.
